Fellows must remain enrolled in their home institution’s doctoralprogram through the end of the advertised fellowship period.Fellowships are endowed with a monthly stipend according to the guidelines of the MaxPlanck Society (https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-fellowship).Applicants should submit the following materials in English through our online applicationportal:1. Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remainenrolled in an accredited graduate program (PhD) through the end of thefellowship1. 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant2. English-language writing sample (maximum 8000 words including notes andbibliography) written by the applicant7. A letter of recommendation from one supervisorThis program is intended to support scholars who wish to improve their academic English.We encourage you to write your application without the use of AI.The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science encourages applications from qualifiedindividuals who belong to groups that are often underrepresented in the workplace due to age,disability, ethnicity, family status, gender, nationality, race, sex, sexual orientation,socioeconomic background, or religion.Please note that only electronic submissions will be accepted.
